verdict.rationale: Cline supports MCP servers, which it describes as a way to 'use external tools and data sources', and its app lets you manage those servers. That gives a generic path to workflow tools. Slack appears only as a channel for chatting with the agent, not as a context source. Missing for 10: documented Jira or Google Drive integrations (official or catalogued MCP servers), Slack as a context/data source rather than a chat interface, in-depth setup docs, and hands-on corroboration of connecting such tools.
